the-general.title: The General
the-general.tagline: He loves two things: his train and his girl.
the-general.description: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer chases it deep behind enemy lines in one of the great chase comedies.
the-general.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Clyde Bruckman · Starring Buster Keaton · Marion Mack

sherlock-jr.title: Sherlock Jr.
sherlock-jr.tagline: A projectionist dreams his way into the movies.
sherlock-jr.description: A small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep on the job and walks straight into the movie on screen.
sherlock-jr.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Kathryn McGuire · Joe Keaton

safety-last.title: Safety Last!
safety-last.tagline: One man. Twelve stories. No net.
safety-last.description: A small-town go-getter promises his sweetheart he has made it big in the city, then has to climb the outside of a skyscraper to prove it.
safety-last.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Mildred Davis

the-freshman.title: The Freshman
the-freshman.tagline: The most popular man on campus — in his own mind.
the-freshman.description: An eager college newcomer tries to become the most popular man on campus and ends up the tackling dummy of the football team.
the-freshman.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Jobyna Ralston

one-week.title: One Week
one-week.tagline: Newlyweds. A build-it-yourself house. What could go wrong?
one-week.description: Newlyweds try to assemble a build-it-yourself house in seven days, not knowing a jealous rival has swapped the numbers on the boxes.
one-week.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Edward F. Cline · Starring Buster Keaton · Sybil Seely

his-girl-friday.title: His Girl Friday
his-girl-friday.description: A fast-talking newspaper editor schemes to stop his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, from quitting and remarrying by handing her one last big story.
his-girl-friday.credits: Directed by Howard Hawks · Starring Cary Grant · Rosalind Russell · Ralph Bellamy

nosferatu.title: Nosferatu
nosferatu.tagline: The original vampire. Still the scariest.
nosferatu.description: A real-estate clerk travels to the Carpathians to close a sale with the reclusive Count, who then follows him home bringing plague and death.
nosferatu.credits: Directed by F. W. Murnau · Starring Max Schreck · Gustav von Wangenheim · Greta Schröder

phantom-of-the-opera.title: The Phantom of the Opera
phantom-of-the-opera.tagline: Beneath the opera house, someone is listening.
phantom-of-the-opera.description: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars beneath the Paris Opera grooms a young singer for stardom, and will kill anyone who stands in his way.
phantom-of-the-opera.credits: Directed by Rupert Julian · Starring Lon Chaney · Mary Philbin · Norman Kerry

night-of-the-living-dead.title: Night of the Living Dead
night-of-the-living-dead.description: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in through the night.
night-of-the-living-dead.credits: Directed by George A. Romero · Starring Duane Jones · Judith O'Dea · Karl Hardman

the-little-shop-of-horrors.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
the-little-shop-of-horrors.description: A hapless florist's assistant breeds a strange plant that makes the shop famous, but it only thrives on human blood.
the-little-shop-of-horrors.credits: Directed by Roger Corman · Starring Jonathan Haze · Jackie Joseph · Mel Welles

carnival-of-souls.title: Carnival of Souls
carnival-of-souls.tagline: She walked away from the crash. Or did she?
carnival-of-souls.description: After surviving a car crash into a river, a church organist starts a new life in Utah but is stalked by a ghoulish figure and drawn to an abandoned pavilion.
carnival-of-souls.credits: Directed by Herk Harvey · Starring Candace Hilligoss · Sidney Berger · Frances Feist

metropolis.title: Metropolis
metropolis.tagline: The city of the future was built in 1927.
metropolis.description: In a towering future city split between idle rulers and underground workers, the ruler's son falls for a prophet of the workers, and an inventor builds a robot in her image.
metropolis.credits: Directed by Fritz Lang · Starring Brigitte Helm · Gustav Fröhlich · Alfred Abel

a-trip-to-the-moon.title: A Trip to the Moon
a-trip-to-the-moon.tagline: The first science-fiction film ever made.
a-trip-to-the-moon.description: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the moon in a giant shell, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and escapes the moon's strange inhabitants.
a-trip-to-the-moon.credits: Directed by Georges Méliès · Starring Georges Méliès · Bleuette Bernon

all-quiet-on-the-western-front.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.tagline: Young men, sold a glorious war.
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.description: A class of German schoolboys enlists in the First World War full of patriotic fire and learns in the trenches what the war really costs.
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.credits: Directed by Lewis Milestone · Starring Lew Ayres · Louis Wolheim · John Wray

d-o-a.title: D.O.A.
d-o-a.tagline: A man reports his own murder.
d-o-a.description: A small-town accountant learns he has been fatally poisoned and has only days left to find out who killed him, and why.
d-o-a.credits: Directed by Rudolph Maté · Starring Edmond O'Brien · Pamela Britton · Luther Adler

man-with-a-movie-camera.title: Man with a Movie Camera
man-with-a-movie-camera.tagline: One day in the life of a city, told only in pictures.
man-with-a-movie-camera.description: A cameraman roams Soviet cities from dawn to dusk in a wordless, restlessly inventive portrait of modern life and of filmmaking itself.
man-with-a-movie-camera.credits: Directed by Dziga Vertov · Edited by Elizaveta Svilova · Starring Mikhail Kaufman

big-buck-bunny.title: Big Buck Bunny
big-buck-bunny.tagline: A gentle giant. Three very rude rodents.
big-buck-bunny.description: A gentle giant rabbit's sunny day is ruined by three bullying rodents, so he plans an elaborate cartoon revenge.
big-buck-bunny.credits: Directed by Sacha Goedegebure · Produced by Blender Foundation

sintel.title: Sintel
sintel.tagline: A girl, a dragon, and a search across the world.
sintel.description: A lone young woman crosses a harsh fantasy world to find the baby dragon she rescued and raised, which was snatched away from her.
sintel.credits: Directed by Colin Levy · Starring Halina Reijn · Thom Hoffman

tears-of-steel.title: Tears of Steel
tears-of-steel.tagline: Amsterdam, the future, and a robot problem.
tears-of-steel.description: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a band of scientists stages a desperate experiment to rewrite a painful breakup that set the machines loose.
tears-of-steel.credits: Directed by Ian Hubert · Starring Derek de Lint · Sergio Hasselbaink · Vanja Rukavina · Denise Rebergen

elephants-dream.title: Elephants Dream
elephants-dream.tagline: Two men inside a machine that makes no sense.
elephants-dream.description: Two men wander an endless, shifting machine world, the older one insisting he knows its rules while the younger begins to doubt him.
elephants-dream.credits: Directed by Bassam Kurdali · Starring Tygo Gernandt · Cas Jansen

cosmos-laundromat.title: Cosmos Laundromat
cosmos-laundromat.tagline: A suicidal sheep gets a second chance. And a third.
cosmos-laundromat.description: On a desolate island, a despairing sheep named Franck meets a strange salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime, with a catch.
cosmos-laundromat.credits: Directed by Mathieu Auvray · Starring Pierre Bokma · Reinout Scholten van Aschat

spring.title: Spring
spring.tagline: A shepherd girl and her dog face the spirits of winter.
spring.description: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient mountain spirits in order to keep the cycle of life turning.
spring.credits: Directed by Andy Goralczyk · Music by Torin Borrowdale

sprite-fright.title: Sprite Fright
sprite-fright.tagline: Teenagers in the woods. Tiny, angry forest sprites.
sprite-fright.description: A group of rowdy teens on a woodland outing tangle with an eccentric nature lover and the adorable-looking mushroom sprites that guard the forest.
sprite-fright.credits: Directed by Matthew Luhn · Hjalti Hjálmarsson

charge.title: Charge
charge.tagline: One shot. Four minutes. No rules.
charge.description: In an energy-starved dystopia, an old man breaks into a battery factory and finds himself trapped with a deadly security droid.

our-hospitality.title: Our Hospitality
our-hospitality.tagline: A feud, a family dinner, and a very long waterfall.
our-hospitality.description: A young man travels South to claim his inheritance and falls for a girl whose family has sworn a blood feud against his, and they cannot shoot him while he is a guest in their house.
our-hospitality.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · John G. Blystone · Starring Buster Keaton · Natalie Talmadge · Joe Roberts

seven-chances.title: Seven Chances
seven-chances.tagline: Marry by 7 p.m. or lose seven million dollars.
seven-chances.description: A broke young stockbroker learns he will inherit seven million dollars if he is married by 7 p.m. that day, and his one newspaper ad brings a stampede of would-be brides.
seven-chances.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · T. Roy Barnes · Ruth Dwyer

steamboat-bill-jr.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
steamboat-bill-jr.tagline: One cyclone. One falling house front. One Buster.
steamboat-bill-jr.description: A college dandy returns home to his gruff riverboat-captain father, falls for the daughter of Dad's rival, and ends up riding out a cyclone in one of the most famous stunts ever filmed.
steamboat-bill-jr.credits: Directed by Charles Reisner · Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Ernest Torrence · Marion Byron

the-navigator.title: The Navigator
the-navigator.tagline: Two millionaires. One empty ocean liner.
the-navigator.description: A spoiled millionaire and the heiress who turned him down end up alone, adrift on an enormous empty ocean liner.
the-navigator.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Donald Crisp · Starring Buster Keaton · Kathryn McGuire

college.title: College
college.tagline: The bookworm goes out for every sport.
college.description: A bookish high-school valedictorian who scorns sports goes to college and tries every athletic event on campus to win the girl.
college.credits: Directed by James W. Horne · Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Anne Cornwall · Harold Goodwin

the-cameraman.title: The Cameraman
the-cameraman.tagline: He bought a newsreel camera to get the girl.
the-cameraman.description: A tintype photographer buys a battered newsreel camera to impress a girl at MGM's newsreel office, and a runaway monkey helps him land the scoop of his life.
the-cameraman.credits: Directed by Edward Sedgwick · Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Marceline Day

speedy.title: Speedy
speedy.tagline: New York's fastest soda jerk. And its last horse car.
speedy.description: A baseball-mad New York soda jerk fights to save his girlfriend's grandfather's horse-drawn streetcar, the last in the city, with a cameo from Babe Ruth.
speedy.credits: Directed by Ted Wilde · Starring Harold Lloyd · Ann Christy · Bert Woodruff · Babe Ruth

animal-crackers.title: Animal Crackers
animal-crackers.description: Captain Spaulding, the famous African explorer, crashes a Long Island society party where a priceless painting goes missing, with all four Marx Brothers at full throttle.
animal-crackers.credits: Directed by Victor Heerman · Starring Groucho Marx · Harpo Marx · Chico Marx · Zeppo Marx · Margaret Dumont

it.title: It
it.description: A spirited department-store salesgirl with plenty of 'It' sets her sights on the store's handsome young owner.
it.credits: Directed by Clarence G. Badger · Starring Clara Bow · Antonio Moreno · William Austin · Gary Cooper

sunrise.title: Sunrise
sunrise.description: A farmer tempted by a woman from the city plots to drown his wife, then spends a long, redemptive day in the city falling in love with her again.
sunrise.credits: Directed by F. W. Murnau · Starring George O'Brien · Janet Gaynor · Margaret Livingston

the-hunchback-of-notre-dame.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
the-hunchback-of-notre-dame.description: In 15th-century Paris, the deformed bell-ringer Quasimodo risks everything to protect the Gypsy dancer Esmeralda from a scheming nobleman and a mob.
the-hunchback-of-notre-dame.credits: Directed by Wallace Worsley · Starring Lon Chaney · Patsy Ruth Miller · Norman Kerry

dr-jekyll-and-mr-hyde.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
dr-jekyll-and-mr-hyde.description: A saintly London doctor tests a potion that splits off his darker self, and the monstrous Mr. Hyde begins to take over.
dr-jekyll-and-mr-hyde.credits: Directed by John S. Robertson · Starring John Barrymore · Martha Mansfield · Nita Naldi

white-zombie.title: White Zombie
white-zombie.tagline: The dead walk the sugar mill.
white-zombie.description: A young couple's wedding trip to Haiti turns to horror when a jealous planter enlists a voodoo master who commands an army of the walking dead.
white-zombie.credits: Directed by Victor Halperin · Starring Bela Lugosi · Madge Bellamy · Joseph Cawthorn

the-terror.title: The Terror
the-terror.description: A lost French officer follows a mysterious woman to the castle of a haunted baron, where a vengeful witch is waiting.
the-terror.credits: Directed by Roger Corman · Starring Boris Karloff · Jack Nicholson · Sandra Knight

dementia-13.title: Dementia 13
dementia-13.tagline: The family has a secret at the bottom of the pond.
dementia-13.description: A scheming widow hides her husband's death from his wealthy Irish family, just as an axe murderer starts stalking their castle.
dementia-13.credits: Directed by Francis Ford Coppola · Starring William Campbell · Luana Anders · Patrick Magee

night-tide.title: Night Tide
night-tide.tagline: Is she a mermaid, or something worse?
night-tide.description: A lonely sailor on shore leave falls for a sideshow 'mermaid' who may be descended from sea creatures that kill by the full moon.
night-tide.credits: Directed by Curtis Harrington · Starring Dennis Hopper · Linda Lawson · Luana Anders

the-bat.title: The Bat
the-bat.tagline: A killer in the mansion. A fortune in the walls.
the-bat.description: A mystery writer rents a country mansion where a fortune is hidden in the walls, and a masked killer called The Bat wants it back.
the-bat.credits: Directed by Crane Wilbur · Starring Vincent Price · Agnes Moorehead · Gavin Gordon

the-stranger.title: The Stranger
the-stranger.tagline: The quiet new professor has a past.
the-stranger.description: A war-crimes investigator tracks a Nazi fugitive to a sleepy Connecticut town, where he is posing as a respected teacher about to marry the judge's daughter.
the-stranger.credits: Directed by Orson Welles · Starring Edward G. Robinson · Loretta Young · Orson Welles

scarlet-street.title: Scarlet Street
scarlet-street.tagline: He painted her. She ruined him.
scarlet-street.description: A meek cashier and Sunday painter falls for a con woman who, with her brutal boyfriend, schemes to sell his paintings as her own.
scarlet-street.credits: Directed by Fritz Lang · Starring Edward G. Robinson · Joan Bennett · Dan Duryea

kansas-city-confidential.title: Kansas City Confidential
kansas-city-confidential.tagline: Four masked men. One framed driver.
kansas-city-confidential.description: A delivery driver framed for an armored-car robbery tracks the masked gang to a Mexican resort to clear his name.
kansas-city-confidential.credits: Directed by Phil Karlson · Starring John Payne · Coleen Gray · Preston Foster · Lee Van Cleef

the-hitch-hiker.title: The Hitch-Hiker
the-hitch-hiker.description: Two friends on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psychopathic killer, and he forces them to drive him across the Mexican desert.
the-hitch-hiker.credits: Directed by Ida Lupino · Starring Edmond O'Brien · Frank Lovejoy · William Talman

suddenly.title: Suddenly
suddenly.tagline: Three gunmen. One small town. One window.
suddenly.description: Three hired gunmen take over a family's hilltop house in a small town to ambush the President's train, with Frank Sinatra as their cold-blooded leader.
suddenly.credits: Directed by Lewis Allen · Starring Frank Sinatra · Sterling Hayden · James Gleason

the-big-combo.title: The Big Combo
the-big-combo.tagline: Cop versus mob, in the dark.
the-big-combo.description: An obsessed police lieutenant goes after a sadistic mob boss, and the key may be the gangster's unhappy girlfriend.
the-big-combo.credits: Directed by Joseph H. Lewis · Starring Cornel Wilde · Richard Conte · Jean Wallace · Lee Van Cleef

blackmail.title: Blackmail
blackmail.description: A Scotland Yard detective's girlfriend kills an artist in self-defense, and a blackmailer who saw her starts squeezing the couple. It was Hitchcock's first talkie.
blackmail.credits: Directed by Alfred Hitchcock · Starring Anny Ondra · John Longden · Cyril Ritchard

the-woman-in-green.title: The Woman in Green
the-woman-in-green.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a string of murders of young women in London, and the trail leads to hypnotism and Professor Moriarty.
the-woman-in-green.credits: Directed by Roy William Neill · Starring Basil Rathbone · Nigel Bruce · Hillary Brooke · Henry Daniell

the-big-trail.title: The Big Trail
the-big-trail.tagline: The Oregon Trail, in John Wayne's first starring role.
the-big-trail.description: A young trapper guides a wagon train of pioneers along the Oregon Trail while hunting the men who murdered his friend. This was John Wayne's first starring role.
the-big-trail.credits: Directed by Raoul Walsh · Starring John Wayne · Marguerite Churchill · El Brendel · Tyrone Power Sr.

angel-and-the-badman.title: Angel and the Badman
angel-and-the-badman.tagline: A gunslinger meets a Quaker girl.
angel-and-the-badman.description: A wounded gunslinger is nursed back to health by a Quaker family, and their daughter's faith starts to pull him away from his outlaw past.
angel-and-the-badman.credits: Directed by James Edward Grant · Starring John Wayne · Gail Russell · Harry Carey

santa-fe-trail.title: Santa Fe Trail
santa-fe-trail.tagline: Bleeding Kansas, on the eve of war.
santa-fe-trail.description: West Point graduates Jeb Stuart and George Custer are posted to Bleeding Kansas and clash with abolitionist John Brown in the years before the Civil War.
santa-fe-trail.credits: Directed by Michael Curtiz · Starring Errol Flynn · Olivia de Havilland · Raymond Massey · Ronald Reagan

the-mark-of-zorro.title: The Mark of Zorro
the-mark-of-zorro.tagline: The fop by day. The fox by night.
the-mark-of-zorro.description: In Spanish California, a foppish young nobleman secretly rides as the masked swordsman Zorro to defend the people against a corrupt governor.
the-mark-of-zorro.credits: Directed by Fred Niblo · Starring Douglas Fairbanks · Marguerite De La Motte · Noah Beery

robin-hood.title: Robin Hood
robin-hood.description: The Earl of Huntingdon returns from the Crusades to find Prince John terrorizing England, and becomes the outlaw Robin Hood to fight back.
robin-hood.credits: Directed by Allan Dwan · Starring Douglas Fairbanks · Wallace Beery · Enid Bennett

the-thief-of-bagdad.title: The Thief of Bagdad
the-thief-of-bagdad.description: A cocky Baghdad thief falls for the Caliph's daughter and sets out on a quest through monsters, magic and a flying carpet to win her.
the-thief-of-bagdad.credits: Directed by Raoul Walsh · Starring Douglas Fairbanks · Julanne Johnston · Anna May Wong

the-black-pirate.title: The Black Pirate
the-black-pirate.tagline: One man versus the pirate crew.
the-black-pirate.description: To avenge his father, a young nobleman joins the pirate crew that killed him, and must rescue a captive princess before the pirates claim her.
the-black-pirate.credits: Directed by Albert Parker · Starring Douglas Fairbanks · Billie Dove · Donald Crisp

the-lost-world.title: The Lost World
the-lost-world.description: Professor Challenger leads an expedition to a remote South American plateau where dinosaurs still roam, and brings a brontosaurus back to London.
the-lost-world.credits: Directed by Harry O. Hoyt · Starring Wallace Beery · Bessie Love · Lewis Stone · Lloyd Hughes

wings.title: Wings
wings.tagline: The first Best Picture. Still soaring.
wings.description: Two small-town rivals for the same girl become fighter pilots and best friends in the skies over WWI France. It won the first Academy Award for Best Picture.
wings.credits: Directed by William A. Wellman · Starring Clara Bow · Charles 'Buddy' Rogers · Richard Arlen · Gary Cooper

hells-angels.title: Hell's Angels
hells-angels.tagline: Howard Hughes's war in the air.
hells-angels.description: Two very different English brothers join the Royal Flying Corps in WWI and are torn apart by war and by the same woman, with some of the most spectacular aerial combat ever filmed.
hells-angels.credits: Directed by Howard Hughes · Starring Ben Lyon · James Hall · Jean Harlow

the-big-parade.title: The Big Parade
the-big-parade.tagline: He marched off to war a boy.
the-big-parade.description: A pampered rich boy enlists after America enters WWI, finds comradeship and love in rural France, and then faces the horror of the front.
the-big-parade.credits: Directed by King Vidor · Starring John Gilbert · Renée Adorée · Karl Dane

meet-john-doe.title: Meet John Doe
meet-john-doe.tagline: The man who never existed became a movement.
meet-john-doe.description: A fired columnist invents a letter from a 'John Doe' threatening suicide in protest, then hires a drifter to play him, and a national movement spins out of control.
meet-john-doe.credits: Directed by Frank Capra · Starring Gary Cooper · Barbara Stanwyck · Edward Arnold · Walter Brennan

a-star-is-born.title: A Star Is Born
a-star-is-born.description: A farm girl with dreams of Hollywood becomes a star with the help of a matinee idol, even as his own career and his drinking drag him down.
a-star-is-born.credits: Directed by William A. Wellman · Starring Janet Gaynor · Fredric March · Adolphe Menjou

the-crowd.title: The Crowd
the-crowd.description: An ambitious young man arrives in New York sure he'll be somebody, then struggles through marriage, loss and a job as one more clerk in the crowd.
the-crowd.credits: Directed by King Vidor · Starring Eleanor Boardman · James Murray · Bert Roach

rain.title: Rain
rain.tagline: A storm, a quarantine and a sinner.
rain.description: Stranded by quarantine on a South Seas island, a defiant prostitute clashes with a fanatical missionary who is determined to reform her.
rain.credits: Directed by Lewis Milestone · Starring Joan Crawford · Walter Huston · William Gargan
